sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Small Parcel Sorting and Direct-Injection Linehaul

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction, no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English common law and French civil law heritage, with customary law recognised under Article 95(2) of the Constitution of the Republic of Vanuatu [Cap 65]
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (signed 2017, ratified 2019) — trade and investment facilitation framework
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with Australia (2011)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with New Zealand (2017)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222], as amended (including beneficial ownership register amendments 2014-2020); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 3 of 2014, as amended; Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap 91]; VFSC AML Rules (2016, as amended); FATF Recommendations as transposed by VFSC guidance.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — beneficial ownership records maintained by the VFSC-licensed registered agent and filed with the VFSC; accessible to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and domestic law enforcement; not publicly searchable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each director, shareholder and beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of each individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a party to the Apostille Convention; consular legalization required only for non-member origin countries)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the individual's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or professional legal reference for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution or legal counsel of the referring jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association of any corporate shareholder or corporate director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate entity's country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (for any corporate shareholder or corporate director)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate entity's country of incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and ongoing screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs and authorised signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI List and the VFSC enforcement database. PEP determination follows the definition in Section 2 of the AML/CFT Act No. 3 of 2014; enhanced due diligence applies to all PEPs, immediate family members and close associates. Screening results must be documented and retained by the registered agent for at least 5 years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Registry Division — International Companies online name search and reservation portal (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must use Latin script in English or French, or a Registrar-approved romanised transliteration. The name must include a suffix denoting limited liability — 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp.' or equivalent — and must not be identical or misleadingly similar to a name already registered or reserved in the VFSC register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days and may be renewed once upon payment of the re-search fee. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a revised name for re-screening within 14 days. An administrative appeal against a refusal may be lodged with the VFSC Registrar within 21 days of the rejection notice, supported by a written submission addressing the cited ground of refusal. A further appeal lies to the Vanuatu Supreme Court by way of administrative judicial review where the Registrar's decision is alleged to be arbitrary or ultra vires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted with conditions — every International Company must maintain a registered office situated in Vanuatu at the premises of a VFSC-licensed registered agent; the e-commerce parcel consolidation hub may be operationally managed from abroad with no physical premises in Vanuatu, provided no local-source revenues are generated and no domestic commercial substance is claimed.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated 5% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection for a tax-exempt IC with no Vanuatu-source activity. VFSC inspection focus is weighted toward the registered agent's records and KYC files rather than the operator's foreign premises. Likelihood rises to material if the entity establishes a physical office or employs staff in Vanuatu.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name search and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per VFSC Schedule of Fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation filing fee (authorised capital up to VUV 100,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per VFSC Schedule of Fees (approx.)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office annual retainer
Beneficial ownership register setup and initial UBO return preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML compliance work

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening subscription plus client due diligence execution
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Screening data provider (engaged via registered agent)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille of the KYC bundle (passports, proof of address, bank references, corporate documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent apostille authority of the origin country
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market tariff (varies by country of origin)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English or French translation of non-Latin script corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator or certified translation agency

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International courier for original executed documents (DHL/FedEx)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Republic of Vanuatu, as amended; incorporation under Section 8; registered office and registered agent obligations under Sections 13–15; directors and secretary under Sections 33–37.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Trust Registry, Port Vila, Efate
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company (Form IC-INC-01) together with an Application for Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow or deposit requirement. Authorized capital is set in the Memorandum, commonly USD 100 divided into 1,000 shares of no par value; share consideration may be paid in any freely convertible currency and need not be verified by the Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscriptions for 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value, as recorded in the register of members, are accepted in full and the shares are allotted to the founding subscriber. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the premises located at the registered office in Port Vila, Efate, Republic of Vanuatu, specified in the registered agent's declaration, are adopted as the Company's statutory registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER, that John Smith and Jane Doe are appointed Director and Corporate Secretary respectively, each to hold office until removed by resolution. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute commercial contracts, and file all statutory returns.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trust Registry (online e-Registry portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three ranked proposed names via a licensed VFSC registered agent in the prescribed Form IC-NAME. The Registry checks the names against the register of International Companies, local companies, and protected statutory designations. Approved names are reserved for 30 days pending incorporation.
required_dossiers: Written authority of the VFSC licensed registered agent
Proof of identity of the proposed ultimate subscriber (notarized passport copy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged as indistinguishable, file an amended application with a new primary name within the unexpired reservation window; no formal appeal fee applies for name re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Registered Agent and Constitutional Drafting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC licensed registered agent (authorized corporate services provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, setting the authorized share capital, share classes, director and secretary provisions, and indemnity clauses. The subscriber executes the constitutional documents and the agent countersigns its consent to act.
required_dossiers: Engagement letter with the licensed registered agent
Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber particulars and consent to act as first director/secretary
Certificate of good standing or reference for the ultimate beneficial owner (bank or lawyer letter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any Registry-side drafting objections through the registered agent; resubmit amended pages with a cover letter within 14 days of the VFSC query notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Incorporation Application with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trust Registry (single desk processing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association together with the Application for Certificate of Incorporation (Form IC-INC-01), the registered office declaration, and officer consents. The Registry checks statutory compliance and allocates a unique company number upon docketing.
required_dossiers: Form IC-INC-01 (executed by the registered agent)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered office consent from the registered agent
Consent to act of each director and the corporate secretary
VFSC statutory fee remittance (USD 350 government fee plus agent professional fee)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registry issues a notice of defect, the registered agent has 21 days to file a corrective submission with supporting documents; failure to cure triggers a fresh filing with a reactivated name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory compliance, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act. The certificate records the company number, name, date of incorporation, and authorized capital. The registered agent releases the certified copies and statutory registers to the directors.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains clerical errors, file a rectification request with the supporting notification letter; duplicate or replacement certificates are issued upon affidavit and payment of a nominal administration fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office Adoption and Officer Appointments (Statutory Post-Incorporation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trust Registry via the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (or adopt a unanimous written resolution) to confirm the registered office at the agent's Port Vila address, approve the initial share allotment, and appoint the first director and corporate secretary. The agent lodges the officer approval record and any change details in the VFSC Register within the statutory filing window.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written resolution of the first board meeting
Register of directors and secretary (Form IC-OFF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late or erroneous officer filings may be corrected through a Declaration of Rectification supported by board minutes; any VFSC late-filing penalty is waived upon first-time voluntary disclosure within 28 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) in coordination with the Department of Local Authorities and the Port Vila or Luganville Municipal Council for business licensing; construction and occupancy oversight by the Public Works Department
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Certificate (VIPA) and Municipal Business Licence issued under the Business Licences Act [Cap. 316]; warehousing and freight handling classification, valid for 12 months and renewable annually

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Registration with Preliminary Environmental Assessment (PEA); full EIA Report is not triggered for a parcel sorting and consolidation warehouse floor area below 2,000 m² situated outside protected or coastal buffer zones
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero liquid effluent discharge to waterways; stormwater runoff must satisfy DEPC water pollution discharge limits (suspended solids < 50 mg/L); no VOC-emitting sorting or packaging processes are permitted; solid waste must be segregated and transferred through DEPC-licensed waste haulers; daytime boundary noise not exceeding 55 dBA and night-time 45 dBA in accordance with municipal noise by-laws

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Vanuatu Police Force / Port Vila Fire Brigade following structural inspection; compliance with the National Building Code and cyclone wind-load standard AS/NZS 1170.2 for warehouse structures; Occupational Health and Safety workplace registration with the Department of Labour under the Health and Safety at Work Act [Cap. 201]; certified manual handling, forklift traffic management, and emergency evacuation plans audited by a licensed OHS consultant

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (VDCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must first incorporate the Vanuatu International Company (IC) through a licensed registered agent at the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); no statutory minimum capital applies. For indirect tax identity, the IC files Form VAT-01 with VDCIR together with the certified Certificate of Incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, registered agent confirmation, director and shareholder identification, and written turnover projections. VAT registration is compulsory when taxable turnover reaches or exceeds VT 2,500,000 in any consecutive 12-month period, and is available by voluntary election below the threshold where input VAT recovery is desired. A unique VAT Registration Number (VRN) is issued by VDCIR. The IC must also obtain a customs exporter identifier in the ASYCUDA World border declaration system for parcel export clearance. No national income tax TIN is issued because Vanuatu does not impose corporate or personal income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax. The International Company is statutorily exempt from all present and future income taxes, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and exchange control under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. Applicable elections are limited to: (1) voluntary VAT registration below the compulsory threshold, subject to a 24-month minimum registration commitment from date of approval; (2) election of duty and VAT deferment procedures for imported goods under customs control; (3) election of zero-rating treatment on qualifying exports of goods and offshore services through documentary substantiation rather than formal application.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998 [Cap 246]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 2,500,000 (two million five hundred thousand vatu) — aggregate value of taxable supplies made in any consecutive 12-month period, or reasonably expected to exceed that level in the following 12 months, without deduction of input VAT
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, cryptographic stamping, or mandatory national e-invoicing regime is in force in Vanuatu. Paper and PDF tax invoices remain lawful and must be issued within 28 days of the supply date and contain: supplier name, address, and VRN; sequential invoice number; date of supply; description and quantity of goods or services; VAT-exclusive consideration; VAT rate; and VAT amount charged. Electronic customs declarations through ASYCUDA World are mandatory for export and import clearance at the frontier, but that system does not operate as a transactional fiscal clearance mandate for domestic or e-commerce invoicing.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are zero-rated under the VAT Act where: (i) the supplier is VAT-registered; (ii) the goods are supplied to a non-resident purchaser or are otherwise destined for export from Vanuatu; (iii) the goods physically leave Vanuatu within the statutory export tolerance period, generally 28 days from the date of supply unless extended by VDCIR; and (iv) the supplier retains adequate written evidence of physical export. Services connected with the parcel consolidation hub, including sorting, co-packing, warehousing, direct-injection line-haul procurement, and export documentation, constitute exported services and are zero-rated where the recipient is a non-resident with no place of business in Vanuatu and the benefit of the service is received entirely outside Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (approved export entry lodged through ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (master and house versions) evidencing physical departure of the consolidated consignment
Consolidation and line-haul manifest generated by the parcel consolidation hub operating system
Commercial invoice and packing list issued against the consolidated consignment
Bank statement, SWIFT MT103, or inward remittance certificate evidencing receipt of foreign currency consideration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VDCIR may conduct retrospective audits across open tax periods and may reassess output VAT at 12.5% with statutory interest and administrative penalties wherever the export documentation bundle is incomplete, inconsistent, or untimely. Fraudulent zero-rating — including false bills of lading, simulated or circular exports, inflated consolidation invoices, or fabricated foreign exchange evidence — triggers full VAT claw-back plus additional penalties under Part VII of the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 246], and criminal liability for false declarations under the Customs Act [Cap 245], with fines, imprisonment, forfeiture of the goods, and deregistration of the VAT registration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - issuer of the VUV and monetary policy authority. Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) licenses offshore banks and supervises AML/CFT under the AML/CFT Act [Cap. 270] and the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current- and capital-account convertibility applies. International Companies are non-resident and face no exchange-control licensing for capital injections, profit remittance, dividend payouts, or liquidation proceeds. The VUV is a managed-float currency linked to a trade-weighted basket (AUD, NZD, USD, JPY, EUR); accounts may be held, funded, and disbursed in any foreign currency. The sole statutory constraint is that an IC must not carry on business with Vanuatu residents, which does not affect cross-border trading, FX, or treasury operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender rules exist: there is no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation window for service-export proceeds. Freight aggregation, consolidation, and linehaul service fees may be received and retained 100% in the invoice currency (USD/EUR/AUD) without RBV approval. Only statistical balance-of-payments survey reporting to the RBV may apply for large individual receipts; this is an informational filing, not a conversion or surrender obligation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BSP Bank (Vanuatu) Limited (Bank of South Pacific)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD/AUD/VUV) and anchor settlement account
Escrow and domestic overhead account (VUV only)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Aspen Bank Limited (VFSC offshore banking licence)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High as a supplementary collection, disbursement, and local-clearing rail (matching the target rails: Airwallex and Local Clearing); Low as the sole treasury anchor. Vanuatu has no domestic EMI licensing regime, so the IC must contract with a foreign-licensed provider (e.g., Airwallex, Wise, or an FCA-authorised EMI). The IC Act prohibitions on domestic Vanuatu business do not impede cross-border flows; the main frictions are the EMI's own enhanced due-diligence screen for tax-exempt offshore entities and the requirement to sweep volatile balances back to the BSP anchor account nightly.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Effectively mandatory. BSP, BRED, and NBV require the beneficial owner and at least one director to attend a physical or live-video interview (with notarised or apostilled passport copies, board resolution, incumbency certificate, registered agent certificate, and a bank reference); fully digital onboarding is not standard for Vanuatu International Companies. A registered office in Port Vila and the issuance of a VFSC Bank Import Permit (obtained through the registered agent) are prerequisites for opening a domestic bank account. Fintech EMIs permit fully remote onboarding, subject to their own KYC/AML files.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore IC with no Vanuatu physical substance triggers correspondent-bank de-risking and enhanced due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, registered agent declaration of non-resident status, IC Act annual compliance filings, board resolution appointing signatories, substance memo mapping actual employees/warehouses to operating countries, and FATCA/CRS self-certifications.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume multi-country payouts to parcel partners and linehaul carriers may resemble fund pass-through or unlicensed money transmission.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or management accounts evidencing a fixed distribution margin, master service agreements with e-commerce platforms, per-counterparty remittance schedules, sanctions screening policy (OFAC/EU/UN), and proof that payouts are made only against invoices and proof-of-delivery (POD) reports without cash settlements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of wealth for shareholder equity injected into a Vanuatu entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-month bank statements of the contributing shareholder, executed share subscription agreement, source-of-wealth letter from an independent accountant, trust deed (if applicable), and tax-residence certificate of the shareholder for FATCA/CRS coherence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Parcel-network destination exposure to sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Geofence denylist of excluded destinations, country volume split, customs-broker licences in each operating country, export declarations, and a VFSC-aligned AML/CFT programme with transaction monitoring and SAR reporting.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home jurisdiction using purpose code 1110 (capital contribution for enterprise) or 1100 where a trading parent funds the hub; beneficiary format: IC legal name, Bank BIC (e.g., BOSPVUVV for BSP Vanuatu), USD or VUV account number, with Field 70 referencing the board resolution number and IC registration number. Verification bundle: share certificate, incumbency certificate, registered agent letter, Bank Import Permit, and FATCA/CRS self-certification. No RBV pre-approval is required for foreign-sourced equity into a non-resident IC.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 for linehaul carrier payments and last-mile partner settlements with purpose code 1229 (other trade-related services) and Field 70 references tying each payment to an invoice/POD set. High-value procurement (sorting equipment, leased aircraft/vehicle capacity) uses confirmed commercial sight Letters of Credit via a top-25 global bank. Bulk low-value payouts use Airwallex Local Clearing rails in destination countries, with nightly sweeps back to the BSP anchor account. Domestic VUV clearing via RBV ACH is limited to the registered-office overhead and resident payroll.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (USD/VUV, AUD/VUV, NZD/VUV) up to 12 months executed with BSP, BRED, or their offshore treasury desks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on AUD and CNH exposure when physical delivery is operationally impracticable; USD remains the consolidated functional base currency
Cross-currency swaps to match long-term lease or fleet-financing liabilities (USD) against AUD/NZD/CNH revenue streams, with interest-rate swaps as an accessory hedge if leverage is introduced

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Maintenance Fee Renewal for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), payable through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 November each calendar year; registered agents typically require client funds by mid-November
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers VFSC-prescribed penalties; continued non-payment exposes the International Company to administrative strike-off from the Register of International Companies after formal notice, with restoration possible only upon payment of all arrears and reinstatement fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return or Financial Statement Filing (Statutory Non-Requirement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not applicable - VFSC does not require or accept annual returns or financial statements from a standard International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No statutory filing date arises; the exemption remains unconditional while the annual maintenance fee is current
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: None; no fine, penalty, or strike-off may be imposed for not filing a return that is not statutorily required. The company must nevertheless maintain accurate registers and settle the annual government fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission through the appointed licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the 30 November renewal; within 30 days of any change in registered office or registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent or notify a change means the company cannot meet its renewal obligations; VFSC may levy late fees, suspend good-standing status, and initiate administrative strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Update and AML/CFT Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not filed publicly; maintained by the registered agent and available for on-demand inspection by VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuously current; updates required within 14 days of any share transfer, allotment, or other change in beneficial ownership, with annual confirmation obtained at renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated UBO/AML records may subject the registered agent and the company to civil monetary penalties, enhanced AML scrutiny, and, in repeated default cases, administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company. There are no revenue, asset, employee, or capital thresholds requiring an independent audit. An audit becomes necessary only when required by the company's constitution, an international banking or insurance licence condition, or a bank, investor, or lender covenant.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) are the most commonly adopted benchmark for voluntarily prepared financial statements, but no statutory filing or audit framework is prescribed. The International Company Act requires only internal records sufficient to explain transactions and support directors' resolutions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public annual UBO filing is required. The registered agent must collect a written confirmation of beneficial ownership at or before the annual renewal date. This confirmation is per-event updated on share transfers, issue of new shares, director changes, or cessation of beneficial ownership. The agent retains the confirmation with the statutory records for VFSC/FIU inspection; it is not submitted to the VFSC as a separate annual return.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book containing resolutions and meetings records
Beneficial Ownership Register maintained by the registered agent

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$350 - US$1,200 per year depending on agent, service package, and compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$4,000 - US$8,000 for a voluntary IFRS audit; lower for a review engagement or agreed-upon procedures

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None. International Companies incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend WHT, and estate tax; the effective corporate rate is permanently 0% with no registration or filing requirement before the Vanuatu Revenue Authority.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No CIT return is required. The sole annual statutory filing is the VFSC Annual Return (Form AR under s.93, International Companies Act [Cap 222]) submitted electronically via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Portal (e-VFSC), together with the annual government fee schedule.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and fee payment must occur within 60 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company legal name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact name appearing on the Certificate of Incorporation; confirm spelling with the registered agent before submission.
Must be a physical address in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed registered agent; P.O. Box is not permitted; non-resident principal may not act as registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent identity and license number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the VFSC-licensed registered agent's name, license number, and contact; all regulatory correspondence flows through the agent.
List full name, residential address, and nationality of each director (minimum one, natural person or corporate); non-resident directors are permitted; a secretary is optional.
Disclose registered and beneficial shareholders; 100% non-resident ownership is lawful; nominee arrangements must be declared to the compliance officer.
State issued shares and par value (if any); no minimum paid-up capital is required under Vanuatu law.

Declare that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu, derived no Vanuatu-source income, and is not a Vanuatu tax resident; any local activity would void the exempt status and require separate GST and licensing review.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a penalty of VUV 5,000 per month or part of a month after the 60-day deadline, plus accrued late government fees. Persistent non-filing for 12 months exposes the IC to strike-off under s.289 of the International Companies Act, asset vesting in the Registrar, and restoration only by VFSC or court order upon payment of all arrears.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Inapplicable at source. Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company, and it maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement network that would further reduce a zero rate. To evidence non-resident status before a foreign revenue authority, the ultimate beneficial owner must obtain from the VFSC a Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Non-Residence, attach the CRS tax identification number, and rely on the applicable foreign domestic credit regime; no Vanuatu TRC is issued because no corporate income tax administration exists.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 0% on both royalty and interest payments made by an International Company to non-residents; treaty intervention is unnecessary, and the zero-rate position must be substantiated in the paying intermediary's records with a VFSC certificate of good standing and a written non-residence declaration.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - VUV 0 (Vanuatu has no statutory transfer pricing regime, no documentation thresholds, and no Local File / Master File obligation for International Companies)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (ESR) apply to 'relevant entities' that are tax resident in Vanuatu or have a physical presence there and conduct 'relevant activities'. The parcel consolidation hub, classified as a distribution and service centre activity, falls within ESR only if managed and controlled from Vanuatu or operating through a Vanuatu fixed place of business; a properly structured non-resident International Company with no Vanuatu premises, staff, or management control is outside ESR scope. Any degree of local management or a Vanuatu booking office triggers full ESR reporting, a non-negotiable requirement to demonstrate economic substance with local staff and expenditure, and automatic information exchange with the EU/OECD if substance is not shown.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false GST (VAT) returns or invoices in respect of domestic Vanuatu supplies, false zero-rating claims on cross-border parcel consolidation services, or unjustified GST refund claims where the IC makes local purchases of warehousing or transport services while claiming absolute offshore exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 2013, monetary penalties up to 200% of the evaded tax, criminal fines up to VUV 10,000,000, and imprisonment up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are jointly and severally liable for the corporate penalty; criminal prosecution attaches personally, with mandatory travel bans pending trial, asset freezing orders, and custodial sentences served on the natural person.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the International Company as a passive letterbox with no economic presence, no records, and no transactional substance while routing e-commerce parcel consolidation revenue through Vanuatu purely to defeat foreign tax law; failure to file the VFSC annual return for more than one year.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and dissolution under s.289 of the International Companies Act; the company's assets vest in the Registrar, it loses capacity to sue or defend, and restoration requires a court order with payment of all arrears and penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors become personally liable for all debts contracted after strike-off; the corporate veil is pierced for fraudulent or abusive use of the IC structure, exposing directors to civil restitution, disqualification orders, and restrictions on leaving Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to appoint a compliance officer, implement AML/CFT policies, identify beneficial owners, or file Suspicious Transaction Reports for parcel-related payment flows processed through Airwallex and local clearing rails; holding client funds without an e-money or money service business license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2014, body corporates face fines up to VUV 100,000,000, responsible individuals face fines up to VUV 25,000,000 and imprisonment up to 15 years; unlicensed money service business activity is separately punishable under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners are subject to personal criminal liability, confiscation of laundered funds, asset seizure, and travel bans; courts may order civil restitution equal to the value of the illicit flows.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Trading and Misrepresentation to VFSC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting false statements in the annual return, issuing invoices without underlying delivery services, continuing to trade while insolvent or after strike-off, or lying to the VFSC or foreign tax authorities about the company's ownership, substance, or activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 12 years under the International Companies Act and the Penal Code; civil liability extends to the full amount of fraudulent debts and induced third-party losses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A court will pierce the corporate veil, rendering directors personally liable for civil restitution; additional sanctions include travel bans, confiscation orders, and disqualification from managing any company in Vanuatu for up to 10 years.
